documents.title: Board Meeting Outcome for Outcome Of Board Meeting 30Th October 2026
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

analysis.summary: Kross Limited reported strong operational performance for Q2 and H1 FY27, driven by robust demand in the commercial vehicles and trailer segments. The company's expansion plans, including the seamless tube facility and backward integration initiatives, are progressing as scheduled with production trials planned for early 2027. Management highlighted that increased commodity and consumable costs impacted margins, but concluded price revisions with OEMs and Tier 1 customers are expected to support upcoming quarters. The company remains optimistic about continued demand momentum across its business segments. Kross Limited reported strong financial and operational performance for Q2 and H1 FY27, driven by robust OEM demand in the M&HCV, trailer, and tractor segments.

guidance.claim: Management expects Q3 and Q4 volumes to be stronger than Q2.
guidance.quote: Based on our current indication, we expect Q3 and Q4 volumes to be stronger than Q2.

guidance.claim: The company expects H2 volumes to be 20% higher than H1.
guidance.quote: Overall volumes and historically also H2 is always 20% up on H1.

guidance.claim: Exports are expected to be 45% higher this year compared to the previous year.
guidance.quote: Year-on-year, we expect this year to be 45% higher than our previous year.

guidance.claim: Q3 and Q4 volumes are expected to be stronger than Q2.
guidance.quote: Q3 and Q4 volumes expected to be stronger than Q2 and historically also H2 is always 10-15% up than H1.

guidance.claim: Further volume scale-up for tipping jacks is expected in H2 FY27.
guidance.quote: Further volume scale-up is expected in H2 FY27 through a structured approach focused on product validation and customer satisfaction

guidance.claim: Kross is well positioned to deliver healthy growth in FY27.
guidance.quote: With healthy order books, sustained demand in the trailer and tractor segments, and multiple capacity expansion initiatives nearing completion, Kross is well positioned to deliver healthy growth in FY27.

guidance.claim: The company expects a growth of 40% to 45% in exports for the financial year.
guidance.quote: We are looking into having a growth of 40%, 45% in our exports for this financial year.

guidance.claim: Management targets export contribution to reach approximately 8% in the next two years.
guidance.quote: We've mentioned this before is that the plan is to have at least 8% of exports coming in in the next two years' time.

demand_outlook.claim: The momentum in the commercial segment has continued with robust demand indicated by the OEMs.
demand_outlook.quote: The momentum in the commercial segment has continued with robust demand indicated by the OEMs.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand in the Agri segment has remained consistent.
demand_outlook.quote: Demand in the Agri segment has remained consistent.

demand_outlook.claim: Continued momentum in commercial vehicles and healthy tractor demand provide good growth opportunities.
demand_outlook.quote: The continued momentum in commercial vehicles, healthy tractor demand and the planned ramp-up for our new products provide good opportunities of growth for us.

demand_outlook.claim: Momentum in the M&HCV segment continued with robust OEM demand.
demand_outlook.quote: M&HCV Segment: Momentum continued with robust OEM demand.

demand_outlook.claim: Trailer segment Q2 volumes exceeded Q4 FY26 levels.
demand_outlook.quote: Trailer Segment: Q2 volumes exceeded Q4 FY26 levels.

demand_outlook.claim: Tractor and agri segment demand remained consistent, supported by relatively low inventory levels of tractors in the market.
demand_outlook.quote: Tractor & Agri Segment: Demand remained consistent, supported by relatively low inventory levels of tractors in the market.

demand_outlook.claim: Tractor and agri segment momentum is expected to continue into Q3.
demand_outlook.quote: Momentum expected to continue into Q3; contribution of this segment set to rise over the coming years.

demand_outlook.claim: The momentum in the commercial vehicle segment from Q4 FY26 continued into Q1 FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: Regarding the M&HCV segment, the momentum in the CV segment from Q4 FY26 continued into Q1 FY27.

demand_outlook.claim: OEMs have indicated strong demand for September Q2 and subsequently Q3 and Q4, supported by healthy order books.
demand_outlook.quote: In spite of that, there has been indications from the OEMs for a strong September Q2 and then subsequently Q3 and Q4. These trends are first time supported by healthy order books.

capex_expansion.claim: Production trials for the seamless tube facility are planned for February or March of 2027.
capex_expansion.quote: The sizing mill and straightening mills have been received and installed, and we plan to undertake production trials in February or March of 2027.

capex_expansion.claim: The company envisages expansion through a strategic increase in axle shaft production and forward integration into manufacturing cold drawn tubes.
capex_expansion.quote: The company further envisages expansion through strategic increase in axle shaft production, forward integration into manufacturing by making Cold Drawn Tubes and enhanced investment in robotic automation for forging operations as well as machining facilities.

capex_expansion.claim: The total budgeted cost for the seamless tube project is approximately INR170 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: Sudhir Rai: No, that's not the figure. You see, we -- the total budgeted cost is approximately INR170 crores, okay?

capex_expansion.claim: Commercial production of extruded axle beams has commenced.
capex_expansion.quote: Commercial production of our extruded axle beams has commenced and capacity utilization is currently expected to deliver cost benefits going forward.

capex_expansion.claim: The seamless tube facility has its mills installed, with production trials targeted for February–March 2027.
capex_expansion.quote: Seamless tube facility: mills installed, production trials targeted for February–March 2027.

capex_expansion.claim: Forging capacity expansion initiatives are on track to support higher volumes and improved cost competitiveness.
capex_expansion.quote: Forging capacity Expansion initiatives on track to support higher volumes and improved cost competitiveness.

capex_expansion.claim: The high-pressure moulding line in the foundry is progressing as planned to double existing casting capacity.
capex_expansion.quote: High-pressure moulding line (Foundry) Progressing as planned to double existing casting capacity.

capex_expansion.claim: Current axle beam capacity stands at 7,500 units per month.
capex_expansion.quote: Current axle beam capacity stands at 7,500 units per month

capex_expansion.claim: The axle beam extrusion line has started production and is fully commissioned.
capex_expansion.quote: We have finally commissioned and productionized our extrusion line.

capex_expansion.claim: A high-pressure mold line for the foundry is expected to start in Q3, which will double foundry capacity.
capex_expansion.quote: A high-pressure mold line for our foundry is expected to start in Q3. This will double our foundry capacity.

capex_expansion.claim: The axle shaft production facility using material gathering and press forging technology is on track for commissioning by September 2026.
capex_expansion.quote: Axle shaft production facility using material gathering and press forging technology is on track for commissioning by September 2026.

margins_costs.claim: Revenue from operations for Q2 FY27 stood at INR235 crores with EBITDA margins of 13%.
margins_costs.quote: During Q2 FY '27, revenue from operations stood at INR235 crores, registering a growth of 80%. EBITDA was INR 30.6 crores and EBITDA margins of 13%, while profit after tax stood at INR (197) million, reflecting to a year-on-year change of 143%.

margins_costs.claim: Price revisions concluded with OEMs and Tier 1 customers are expected to support the company during Q3 and Q4.
margins_costs.quote: While we have witnessed some pressures from rising consumable and commodity costs, the price revisions, including -- concluded with the OEMs and Tier 1 customers are expected to support us during the Q3 and Q4.

margins_costs.claim: Steel prices have been increasing every quarter.
margins_costs.quote: Steel has been increasing, you could say, every quarter.

margins_costs.claim: Price revisions with most OEMs and Tier-1 customers were concluded, supporting profitability despite input-cost pressures.
margins_costs.quote: Price revisions with most OEMs and Tier-1 customers concluded, supporting profitability despite input-cost pressures.

margins_costs.claim: Current axle beam capacity utilisation is approximately 60–65%.
margins_costs.quote: Axle beam extrusion plant: Commercial production has commenced; current utilisation approximately 60–65%.

margins_costs.claim: Q2 FY27 EBITDA margin stood at 13.0%.
Q2 FY27 Gross Profit Margin was 43.9%.
EBITDA grew by 39.5% year-on-year to 225.54 million with margin expansion to 12.23%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA grew by 39.5% year-on-year to 225.54 million with margin expansions to 12.23%, while PAT increased 24.4% year-on-year to 133.12 million.

margins_costs.claim: A steel price settlement retrospective to suppliers was given at INR4,700 per kilo around the 15th of July.
margins_costs.quote: One is with the commodity price increase, that is steel for us. So steel, there has been a very recent settlement which has been given retrospective to all the suppliers. This has just happened around the 15th of July where INR4,700 per kilo has been given.

orders_capacity.claim: Exports now contribute approximately 8% of the component business.
orders_capacity.quote: Exports now contribute approximately 8% of our component business.

orders_capacity.claim: Trailer segment contributed close to 49% of revenue, while the component business contributed 51% for Q2 FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: If you look into our sales segment mix for this specific quarter, our trailer segment has contributed close to 49% of our revenue, while the component business contributed the balance 51%.

orders_capacity.claim: Installed capacity for tipping jacks is 800 kits/month.
orders_capacity.quote: Installed capacity of 800 kits/month providing substantial headroom for future growth.

orders_capacity.claim: Volumes on axles and suspensions have increased 30% year-on-year.
orders_capacity.quote: The extruded axle beam has started production and volumes on axles and suspensions have increased 30% year-on-year.

orders_capacity.claim: Tipping jacks sales reached 226 units in Q1 of FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: We have sold 226 in Q1 of FY27 and we hope to further scale this in the subsequent quarters.

orders_capacity.claim: Overall axle volume for Q1 stood at approximately 9,500 numbers and suspension volumes at around 3,200 to 3,300 numbers.
orders_capacity.quote: Yes, the overall axle volume is almost at 9,500 numbers and the suspension volumes are at around 3,200, 3,300 numbers, both mechanical and air put together.

capital_allocation.claim: A preferential issue to the tune of INR63.6 crores was witnessed.
capital_allocation.quote: The company is completely focused on capacity expansion and gearing up for the coming years, which is also witnessed by a preferential issue to the tune of INR63.6 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: The seamless tube project is funded through a mix of debt and internal accruals.
capital_allocation.quote: Funded through a mix of debt & internal accruals

capital_allocation.claim: IPO fund utilization has been fully completed as per the plan.
capital_allocation.quote: On our fund utilization from the IPO, we have utilized fully as per the plan.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management witnessed pressures from rising consumable and commodity costs.
risks_headwinds.quote: While we have witnessed some pressures from rising consumable and commodity costs, the price revisions, including -- concluded with the OEMs and Tier 1 customers are expected to support us during the Q3 and Q4.

risks_headwinds.claim: The period of June and July experiences slightly subdued demand due to monsoon.
risks_headwinds.quote: The period of June, July are where demands are slightly subdued due to monsoon.

management_commitments.claim: Production trials for the seamless tube facility are planned for February or March of 2027.
management_commitments.quote: The sizing mill and straightening mills have been received and installed, and we plan to undertake production trials in February or March of 2027.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects Q3 and Q4 volumes to be stronger than Q2.
management_commitments.quote: Based on our current indication, we expect Q3 and Q4 volumes to be stronger than Q2.

management_commitments.claim: By Q3 or Q4, trailer axles will be produced exclusively through the extruded beam process.
management_commitments.quote: This particular aspect of business by Q3 or Q4, we will be producing our trailer axles in this methodology only by the extruded beam process.

management_commitments.claim: The axle shaft production facility using material gathering and press forging technology is scheduled for commissioning by September 2026.
management_commitments.quote: Axle shaft production facility using material gathering and press forging technology is on track for commissioning by September 2026.

management_commitments.claim: Order books from the new European tier 1 supplier are expected to come in from H2 onwards.
management_commitments.quote: We should see order books coming in from that supplier from H2 onwards.

management_commitments.claim: Export contribution to revenues is targeted to reach approximately 8% in the next two years.
management_commitments.quote: We've mentioned this before is that the plan is to have at least 8% of exports coming in in the next two years' time.
